about_the_game:
Break through Germany’s last line of defense.

In Panzer Corps 2 - Frontlines: Westwall, you take command of US Army formations as they battle through the formidable Siegfried Line between September and December 1944. What starts as a rapid advance into a crumbling enemy front quickly escalates into a grueling, high-stakes campaign where every inch of ground must be earned.

Campaign Overview

After the collapse of German forces in the Falaise Pocket and the liberation of Paris, your next objective is clear: push to the German border and crack open the Westwall.

Soon your offensive will reach the strategically vital corridor between Maastricht and Aachen, where early gains come fast, but don’t get too comfortable. The deeper you push, the more entrenched the enemy becomes. From the fortified bands outside Aachen, to the brutal Huertgen Forest and the Roer Plains, you’ll face a hardened German resistance that refuses to break.

Later, your attention shifts south to Lorraine and the Saar region, as you strike toward the Siegfried Line from France and fight your way toward Germany's industrial core.

Key Features

  • Command historic battles never before featured in official Panzer Corps content

  • Experience a dynamic difficulty curve: early victories give way to fierce resistance

  • Engage in a wide variety of mission types, from open-armored assaults to tight urban and forest combat

  • Confront heavily fortified areas that demand tactical precision and patience

  • Enjoy new visuals including custom officer portraits, briefings, and campaign maps

New Units & Equipment

  • Field Armor Sherman TanksDeploy improvised variants of standard Shermans reinforced with sandbags, track links, planks, and makeshift armor. These rare units feature unique traits, improved stats, and are available in limited numbers via objectives and reinforcements.

  • Westwall Fortifications

    • Dragon’s Teeth: Anti-tank obstacles that can’t fight back, but are tough to destroy and slow your advance.

    • Pillboxes: Modest on their own, but deadly in large, interconnected defensive networks.

  • Dodge WC-63 TruckA lightweight, cheaper transport option for specific infantry and lighter artillery.

  • Enhanced US Air UnitsGain access to upgraded aircraft variants to secure air superiority across the front.

Are you ready to break through the Westwall?
